description: Canonical resume section concepts and the heading label variants recognized as matching each. Used by ats_engine.rules_sections to detect whether standard sections are present and clearly labeled. An unusual/creative heading not in this list is not automatically wrong -- it's flagged as a Possible ATS Risk / Positioning Opportunity for the recruiter-readability reason, not asserted as a parsing failure.
note: Not yet backed by a live-fetched citation (Phase 9 / research/ module is where real sourced URLs get attached). Restated from general, widely-repeated career-guidance convention -- treat as Level E internal heuristic until a real source is recorded.
